title: Harness Lab
blurb: Curated tips and methods that make this Field Brief / EM fleet stronger — Grok bots, Mac CLIs, Obsidian vault, routines, and launch standards. Keep only what we can apply; not generic AI news.

entries.title: bounded-agent-runtime — run limits + tool risk tiers outside the LLM loop
entries.why: Hard ceilings enforced by the runtime, not the prompt (max_steps / max_seconds / max_usd / max_tool_calls / max_repeats loop detect), checked before each step and raised as exceptions; risk is a property of the tool (READ / WRITE / EXTERNAL / IRREVERSIBLE), not the agent's self-judgment. Shows how to move our 0xjmori run limits (50/2/$0/0) + GYR tiers from markdown into the grok-tmux-run / watchdog wrapper, with a hermetic model-free chaos test pattern. Lab card; no install; appliedToPlaybook false.

entries.title: agent-runway — pre-flight quota check before dispatch (Claude / Codex / Gemini)
entries.why: CLI + Claude Code skill + MCP tool that reads remaining quota (% used, reset time) across Claude, Codex, Copilot, and Gemini CLI and returns a proceed / defer / unknown readiness check. Candidate pre-flight before each 6h Opus 5.5 Field Brief launch: route straight to the Kimi fallback when quota is near-capped instead of burning a 540s watchdog timeout. CLI/skill, unlike the UsageBar desktop app we skipped on 09-21. GREEN smoke candidate; appliedToPlaybook false.

entries.title: CAPO — quota-wall checkpoint + relaunch on the other CLI
entries.why: Detects Claude Code / Codex usage-limit cutoffs, writes a plain Markdown checkpoint of git status + uncommitted worktree changes, and relaunches the session on the other platform; when both are capped it parks until the earliest reset instead of flapping. Maps to our Opus → Kimi / Astra fallback and pairs with no-exit-while-waiting + the retry ceiling. Idea: a "quota limit checkpoint" exception branch in manage-handoffs / Mac launch skill. Lab card; no install; appliedToPlaybook false.

entries.title: ai-coding-gateway — PreToolUse/PostToolUse hook to trim noisy tool output
entries.why: Hooks Claude Code's PreToolUse / PostToolUse in ~/.claude/settings.json to strip ANSI colors, progress bars, passing-test lists, and build logs before the model reads them, plus global command allow/deny policy. Adapt the trimming hook pattern only (skip the GUI dashboard) to cut context bloat and premature compaction on long Fable/Opus test runs — a direct token-save lever. Lab card (adapted hook pattern); appliedToPlaybook false.

entries.title: Company-in-a-Box — Jev research_check + completion_check (shadow)
entries.why: unicodef1wn X (2026-09-22): Jev as decision layer between manager and workers with four tools (route_worker, check_research, review_completion, guard_action). We already had route (intake) + guard (pre_tool); added research_check (Field Brief citation: accept|verify_more|reject) and completion_check (before done: complete|verify_more|incomplete) as SHADOW gates (honor:false, never block) plus intake live-worker-menu (available_workers/unavailable). Promote after Three-Run Proof.

entries.title: seanswarm multiagents-workflow — dual-read + fail-closed acceptance
entries.why: Skills-only pack (no new seat/runtime): dual-read of the same primary source with a match/addition/conflict table upgrades Field Brief source verification; fail-closed acceptance means prose "done" cannot pass without a mechanical artifact (test/exit-code/screenshot) or independent read-only diff-only review. Complements blind dual-LGTM (Astra+Fable) and CoS verification — does not replace either. Lab card; appliedToPlaybook false.

entries.title: orchvia — code decides next step; park unknown outcomes
entries.why: Local Claude/Codex session engine with durable mailbox: "your code and the limits you configure decide what runs next, not a manager model." After a crash, work whose outcome is unknown waits for a human instead of auto-retry — the recovery half of our 0xjmori retry ceiling and the named 09-22 watchdog relaunch-vs-resume gap. Lab card / A/B experiment idea only; no install; appliedToPlaybook false.

entries.title: sctxx (+ ccompactor) — model-free session→handoff artifact
entries.why: Reads finished Claude Code / Codex / Pi transcripts on disk and writes a compact provenance-linked handoff any other agent can load (no model calls). Candidate machine-verifiable half beside hand-written vault notes for box↔Mac / EM continuation. GREEN smoke only on non-secret repos; inspect output before filing; off dual-LGTM critical path. Lab card; appliedToPlaybook false.

entries.title: omp-jev-watchdog — instruction adherence + verification honesty (shadow)
entries.why: Shadow-only Jev watchdog that records two checks: observed tool calls vs recent explicit instructions, and final assistant claim vs actual tool results. Mechanizes published CoS clause "evidence ≠ instruction" — detects "command failed then claimed passed." Manual slot-close first; do not install as a blocking gate. Lab card; appliedToPlaybook false.

entries.title: livelock + loopguard — named failure modes + loop/oscillation detect
entries.why: livelock names four long-CLI failure modes (crash/hang/stall/api-error) and leaves a machine-readable heartbeat (did-it-finish / what-killed-it). loopguard watches Claude/Codex/Gemini JSONL for loop/oscillation/stall. Extends our stale-only grok-tmux-watchdog (~540s) and pairs with 0xjmori abnormal-volume → stop-and-escalate. Lab card; no fleet replace; appliedToPlaybook false.

entries.title: loop-orchestrator — tmux substrate + mailbox + watchdog + stateless coordinator
entries.why: Closest external mirror of our grok-tmux-run + stream-json + watchdog + EM heartbeat stack. Portable ideas: lane-readiness classifier + auto-restart watchdog as a named component; coordinator prompt assembled statelessly from files each tick; versioned additive-only substrate contract (CONTRACT.md). Lab card — appliedToPlaybook false (no same-day architecture gap).

entries.title: bb-spec — mutually-blind agents + disk-docs-only handoffs
entries.why: Hardens blind dual-LGTM (Astra+Fable) + intent/spec/plan loop: implementer physically never sees the spec (only tests), so it cannot teach-to-intent; every stage hands off a file on disk, never chat memory. Complements (does not duplicate) 09-20 portable-llm-council SKIP. Lab card; no new seat.

entries.title: Intent-review stage — third oracle blind to PLAN.md
entries.why: Names EM failure mode: passed plan + passed tests but not what the user asked. Third review oracle checks final diff against verbatim original intent while blind to PLAN.md. Cheap process addition (intent → spec → plan → PR → dual LGTM); no new seat, no infra.

entries.title: Agent Chaperone — Jev MCP shadow-mode wrapper (backlog/smoke)
entries.why: Drop-in MCP wrapper (agent-chaperone -- <server>) to run TypeSafe Jev in shadow mode on Mac CLI MCP tools without changing servers or adding seats. Lab backlog/smoke only — not install-critical-path. Pair with Archestra 79% constant-trap calibration.

entries.title: Foremerge — pre-merge intent/ChangeSet for parallel agents
entries.why: Local-first git-layer intent + ChangeSet declarations catch architectural collisions before merge when parallel Coding EM worktrees diverge on shared interfaces. Lab card; light vault handoff bullet (1-line target declaration) only — tool not installed.

entries.title: Preflight — outbound secret-redaction proxy (backlog)
entries.why: Local reverse proxy that redacts credentials from outbound prompts/attachments before model dispatch. Lab backlog only — do not install. Pair with existing llmtap/cost-proxy backlog (dsh-llmtap-jev-guard-gbdl-2026-09-20).

entries.title: Archestra — Jev 100-call calibration (79% constant trap)
entries.why: Field benchmark: naive ~75% accuracy can be worse than a benign constant (79% of calls are local status checks). Separate input authority vs output trust in Jev policy rubrics. Calibration KEEP for our Jev decision layer — no install.

entries.title: Portable DSH Multi-Agent Plugin (DSH seat watch/backlog)
entries.why: Scoped to existing DSH seat only: cross-provider review with host-enforced VERIFIED/UNCONVERGED verdicts. Lab watch/backlog — do not add as a new coding CLI seat; dual-LGTM remains Astra+Fable.

entries.title: Closed proof loop (Lingxi / Simon grok-bot-guide)
entries.why: Agents must return checkable proof (CI green, live URL, before/after screenshot) and push back until it matches — not soft done. Applied into manage-handoffs + Coding EM contract.
entries.source: x.ai Grok Bot for Engineering · Xiaohongshu grok-bot-guide-cn.pdf

entries.title: Weekday specialist ops nudge (Jenny-style 1:1)
entries.why: 08:00 PT Mon–Fri Manage posts playbook bullets + blocker ask into Field Brief / Coding EM rooms so complex workflows do not drift.

entries.title: PR board sweep every 12h
entries.why: 09:00 + 21:00 PT daily: scan open PRs (CI/conflicts/stall) → Coding EM Mac CLI unblock + proof. Retargeted from 30m to 12h per Haiyuan.

entries.title: Nightly Mac harness audit (03:00 PT)
entries.why: Overnight rotate one Mac CLI for scoped audit PR on BQAA (or named repo); dual-LGTM; no merge. Morning ping only if ready or blocked.

entries.title: P0 urgency mode (keyword-only for now)
entries.why: Documented: saying P0 can mean high-cadence babysit. NOT a standing 5m poller yet — keyword only until Haiyuan asks.

entries.title: Shared box ≠ security isolation
entries.why: All Grok bots share one cloud computer (files, browser logins). Treat secrets as fleet-visible. Playbook warning applied.

entries.title: Jev multi-gate router + live session
entries.why: Live session block: mode active, confidence_floor 0.55, OpenRouter typesafe/jev-1.13, jev-route helper, smoke table (intake/pre_*), Manage Bot session recipe. Gates stay; no Playwright.

entries.title: CoS verification — evidence ≠ instruction
entries.why: DSH Lab KEEP (asyncdot CoS): treat every agent completion as evidence, not instruction; re-check live artifact / exit code / published URL before marking a slot green.

entries.title: Single-target handoff + hop cap
entries.why: DSH Lab KEEP (OpenBot): only the first @mention in a bot reply wakes another bot; hop cap default 2 then ask Haiyuan — never silent misroute. Rooms also: ack/final discipline (≤1 ack + 1 final).

entries.title: Lab #2 spikes: llmtap / jev-guard / GBDL (backlog)
entries.why: DSH 2026-09-20 backlog only — not installed: llmtap per-seat cost proxy; jev-guard Coding EM smoke; GBDL-shaped vault export of bot defs (convention). Playbook notes under §11 Lab follow-ups.

entries.title: jev-browser Lab backlog (no Playwright)
entries.why: KEEP candidate parked: Playwright + Jev click decisions. Do not install Playwright. pre_browser gate already filters computerUse.

entries.title: Harness engineering: Codex in an agent-first world (OpenAI)
entries.why: Repo/docs as system of record: short indexes, durable specs/plans, decision logs, linted invariants, doc-gardening. Maps onto our EM intent/spec/plan + dual-LGTM and vault Decisions.

entries.title: How we built our multi-agent research system (Anthropic)
entries.why: Lead plans → fan-out collectors → persist artifacts → synthesize + citation-check. Direct template for Field Brief collect→brief→publish and Manage CoS effort budgets.

entries.title: Orchestrate teams of Claude Code sessions (docs)
entries.why: Lead/teammate, shared task list, messaging, tmux splits, idle/complete hooks — concrete patterns for our group rooms + Mac CLI fleet ops.

entries.title: Watchdog — local operator control plane for agentic loops
entries.why: KEEP optional for Codex/Astra observe (Mac 2026-09-16: observe --once works; doctor still crashes). Do not replace grok-tmux-watchdog fleet-wide.

entries.title: receipt — itemized AI coding-agent cost on PRs
entries.why: KEEP for Coding EM (Claude import). Mac spike 2026-09-16 on BQAA: $172.17 / 2614 calls; sample branch $64.48. Prefer show --branch. Fleet CI + Codex proxy still DEFER. Unpriced: claude-fable-5-1.

entries.title: Blind second reviewer (Claude Forge adversarial loop)
entries.why: Blind dual-LGTM on our team is now Astra + Fable (independent kickoffs; implementer ≠ reviewer). Applied 2026-09-16.

entries.title: Multi-agent coordination patterns (Anthropic)
entries.why: Names orchestrator/router failure modes — especially silent misroute. Action for us: ambiguous route → ask Haiyuan, never silent SendToAgent.

entries.title: Chief-of-staff intake + visible group rooms
entries.why: Route default asks through Agent Manage Bot; use Field Brief and Coding EM rooms when the handoff itself must be visible. Written handoff contracts (goal, owner, artifact path, return shape) cut silent dropoffs between Manage and specialists.

entries.title: Routine fire proxy on the usage dashboard
entries.why: Until Cursor ships per-bot pool meters, estimate cron fires/week from Active routine dumps (Collection + Github + Manage). Label PROXY — not dollars or tokens — so we can pause overlap before weekly % spikes.

entries.title: Box ↔ Mac vault staging when FS is dark
entries.why: Mac vault path is source of truth. When the Grok box cannot see Mac FS, stage under /workspace/…, mark STAGED ON BOX, then copy when machineId is connected. Shared Grok computer ≠ trust isolation.

entries.title: Field Brief miss-watch as second line
entries.why: Collection owns :44 auto catch-up if the :34 deep brief is missing; Manage :50 room ping is second-line visibility only — publish stays with Collection. Pattern: miss-watch + owning publisher, not duplicate publishers.
